content: John the Baptist kuku yirrkan.
Yanyu kuku ngulkurr Jesusanka, nyulu Godumu kangkal.
Ngadi-ngadiku Isaiahangka yanyu Godumu kuku kabanba balkan,

content.text: “Milka-janay. Ngayu dingkar kukuji yungal jakalba yununku. Nyulu dingkarangka bama ready-bungal yununku.
Nyulu yirrkay-yirrkay bubungu jirrbu-jirrbungu, ‘Readymakada, Maja God kadanyamunku. Junkayku bunday, ngulkurrku bunday. Readymaka nyungunku.’”

content: John nguwimal milbijinda bubungu jirrbu-jirrbungu, Godumu kuku yirrkan. Nyulu yalaman, “Yurra buyun-buyunmun jurrkijika! Ngayu yurrangan banabu dukul-damal, Godungku yurrandamun buyun-buyun kidanya, milka-wulanya yinyaynka buyun-buyunku.”
Bama wubulku Johnundu kadarin bubumun Judeamun, townmun Jerusalemmun. Jana mala-yirrkan buyun-buyunku, Johnungku jananin banabu dukul-damanda wawubajanga Jordan.
Johnumu kambi camelandamun mungkamun balkan. Wayarrimundu yulbanda nyulu kajan-kajajin. Mayi nyungu wunba, minya nyungu yinja-yinja.
Johnungku Godumu kuku balkan. Nyulu yalaman, “Dingkar nyubunku ngaykunku kudamundu kaday. Ngayu yala nyululu kari. Nyulu maja ngulkurr bajaku, ngayu buyun. Nyulu junkurrji, ngayu burdal.
Ngayu yurrangan banabu dukul-daman. Nyulu yurrangan dukul-damal nyunguwundu Wawubu dayirrda.”
Johnungku Jesus banabu dukul-daman.
Yala-yalaku Jesus townmun Nazarethmun, bubumun Galileemun Johnundu kadan. Johnungku nyungun banabu dukul-daman wawubajanga Jordan.
Jesus banamun wandin, nyulu wangkar-wangkarda nyajin, jiri walngajinya. Nyulu Godumu Wawu nyajin kankadanya wangkar-wangkarmun nyungundu. Godumu Wawu yala dikal bakamu.
Godungku jirimun yalaman, “Ngayu wawurr-wawurrman yununku. Yundu ngayku kangkal. Ngayu yununku wawu jirray.”
Dubungku Jesus milka-bakan buyun-damanka.
Wawubu Godundumundu Jesus jinbalku yungan bubungu jirrbu-jirrbungu.

Nyulu bubungu jirrbu-jirrbungu bundan 40 days, kayandamunbu wild-balandamunbu bubungu. Yinyaymba Dubungku Satanangka Jesus milka-bakan buyun-damanka, yamba Jesus kari milka-janan. Jiri-warrangka nyungunin ngulkurrduku kujin.
Jesusangka dingkar 4-bala kunjan.
Kanbalda bamangka John the Baptist karrban, jailba nandan. Wawu yinyamun, Jesus bubungu Galilee dungan, Godumu kuku balkanka.
Nyulu yalaman, “Timeda God maja jirraymanka. Yurra buyun-buyunmun jurrkijikakuda. God kuku nyakakuda, nyungu kuku ngulkurr believeim-bungakuda.”
Jesus yikindarrda jalundurr Galileeburr dungan-dungan, nyulu bulanin yaba-yabaju Simon, Andrew nyajin, makarr yilbanya, minya kuyu maninka, sellim-bunganka.
Jesusangka bulanda yalaman, “Yubal minya kuyu manin-manil. Ngaykunji kaday, yubal bamada maninka, jana Godundu jurrkijinka.”
Bula makarr bawanyarrkuda, nyungunji dungan.
Jana yubaku jarra dungarin, bulayan yaba-yabaju James and John nyajin, makarr ngulkurr-bunganya bulawunbu boatbu. Bulanga nganjan Zebedee.
Kanbal bama jananji workmanmanijin boatbu. Jesusangka bulanin yaba-yabaju kunjan, bula nganjan boatbuku bawan kanbalanji, Jesusanji dunganda.
Dingkar Dubunji bundandan.

Jana Jesus townbu Capernaum dungarin. Janawunbu bubungu bama wubulku Saturdaymundurr wawu-kujijin lawmunku. Saturdaynga jana Jesus Jew-warrandamunbu churchmunbu walan, Jesusangka bama wubulku binal-bungan.
Jana kungkurr-kadarin nyunguwunku kukuku, nyulu junkurr-murubuku binal-bunganya, kari yala teacher-teacherangka ngadimunku.
Nyubun dingkar dubunji, nyulu churchmunbu walan.
Nyulu dingkar yirrkan, “Ya, yundu Jesus, yundu townmunku Nazarethmunku. Yundu ngalinyanda wanjarrmal? Ngalinin buyun-damanka? Ngayu yununku binal. Yundu Godumu kangkal, yundu junkay bajaku.”
Jesusangka dubu murru-kangan, yalaman, “Jankamaka! Wandi nyunguwunmun dukurrmun!”
Dubungku dingkar burra-warri-maninda, yaykarrku yirrkan, dingkarandamun dukurrmun wandinda.

Jana bama wubulku kungkurr-kadarin, jana-karrajiku balkawan, yalaman, “Ya, wanyu yinya? Yanyu kuku jirakal. Jesus junkurrjikuda. Nyulu dubu-dubundu junkurr-murubuku balkan, dubu-dubungku nyungun kuku nyajinda.”
Bama wubulku yiringkurr bubungu Galilee balkan-balkawan Jesusanka.
Jesusangka bama wubul ngulkurr-bungan bambaymun.
Jana Jesus, James, John, jana Jew-warrandamun churchmun wandirin, dungarinda bayanba Simonandamunbu bulalandamunbu Andrewndumunbu.
Simonamu biwul bambay wunanan, feverji. Jana Jesus balkan nyungunku.
Jesus nyungundu kadan, nyungu mara karrban, janay-manin. Jalbu ngulkurrkuda, karida bambay, karida wumbul. Nyulu jananga mayi wambajinda.
Bama kanbal bambay, bama kanbal dubu-dubunji. Wungar daran, bamangka yinyarrin bama wubulku wundin Jesusanda.
Bama wubul bajaku murumarin jakalba bayanba.
Jesusangka bama bambaymun walu-yindu walu-yindumun ngulkurr-bungan, dubu-dubu kangan dukurrmun. Nyulu dubu-dubundu balkan, “Jankamaka,” dubu-dubu Jesusanka binalmanya.
Jesus kuku yirrkan bubungu Galilee.
Yalibalaku nguwul-nguwulbuku Jesus dungan bubungu jirrbu-jirrbungu, Godunji balkawanka.
Yamba jana Simonangka nyungun nubin.
Jana nyungun warrmba-bungan, nyungundu yalaman, “Bamangka wubulduku yunun nubil-nubil.”
Jesusangka jananda yalaman, “Ngana townbu yindu-yinduymbu dungari. Ngayu kadan, bamanda wubulbuku balkanka Godundumunku kukuku.”
Nyulu yiringkurrku dungan bubungu Galilee, Godumu kuku Jew-warrandamunbu churchmunbu kanbalba balkan-balkan, dubu-dubu kangan-kangan bamandamun dukurrmun.
Jesusangka dingkar ngulkurr-bungan bambaymun.
Bama yindu nyungundu kadan, yinya bama bambay, bajiji, leprosymunji. Nyulu bungkubu janan, Jesusanda babajin, “Yundu nganya ngulkurr-bungangarr. Yindu binal ngulkurr-bunganka.”
Jesus jiba-badin nyungunku. Jesusangka marabu karrban nyungun, yalaman, “Yundu ngulkurrkuda.”
Bambay leprosy kunbaynda, dingkar ngulkurrkuda.

Jesusangka yinyayanda bamanda junkurr-murubuku balkan, “Yundu bama yindu-yindu kari balka yinyaynka. Yundu milbijika dingkaranda priestanda churchmunbu. Law wukurrika, law Mosesangka ngadiku kabanba balkan. Minya wayju bayanga, yala lawmundu balkan. Yinyamundu balka, bamanda wubulbuku milbinka yundu ngulkurrda bambaymun.” Yinyamun Jesusangka nyungun yunganda.

Yamba yinya bama Jesusanda kari milka-janan. Nyulu dungan, bamanda wubulbuku balkan Jesusangka nyungun ngulkurr-bungan. Wawu yinyamun Jesus kari townbu dungan baja, bama wubulku murumarinya nyungundu. Yinyaynka nyulu bubungu bama-karinga bundanda. Yinyamun bama wubulku nyungundu kadarinda bubumun yindu-yindumun.
